: "Genetek is using mysterious technology to corrupt Palmon. The innocent Meowdame has lost its sanity and become extremely vicious.
Defeat Genetek's Bullypunks, obtain the map, track down Meowdame, and purify the corrupted power within it!
Set out! Save Meowdame and make it your companion!"
: "Please defeat the summoned Corrupted Meowdame first."

: "1. The event lasts for 4 days and is open all day during the event period.
2. During the event, rally to defeat Bullypunks to obtain Trail Maps. Explorers who participate in rallies also have a chance to obtain a Trail Map. A maximum of 30 Trail Maps can be obtained daily by initiating or participating in rallies.
3. The Trail Map can be used in the inventory to summon the Corrupted Meowdame. Rally to defeat the Corrupted Meowdame to obtain a Meowdame Token.
4. Once summoned, the Corrupted Meowdame will remain for 1 hour. Explorers should challenge it promptly."

: "1. Dojo Challenges are available from Monday to Sunday.
2. Each week at opening time, explorers will be assigned to a zone based on their Camp level. The higher the zone level, the greater its Dojo Prestige rewards.
3. You can only be assigned to one competition stage each week.
4. Dojos are located within 4 elemental zones. Occupy a Dojo to collect its corresponding elemental energy. Each zone contains 1 Champion Dojo, 8 Elite Dojos, and more Regular Dojos. Higher-level Dojos produce more elemental energy.
5. Collect from an unchallenged Dojo that's 100% occupied to trigger a special event and receive bonus rewards. There's also a chance to trigger a special event when challenging an 100% occupied Dojo.
6. You can challenge a Dojo occupied by another player. A successful challenge will transfer the Dojo to you. Your first challenge each day is free; subsequent challenges have a 10-minute cooldown and cost Pallite.
7. You can challenge Dojos occupied by other players up to 6 times per day. Challenging Dojos with more resources will yield greater rewards." -> "1. Dojo Challenges are available from Monday to Sunday.
2. Each week at opening time, explorers will be assigned to a zone based on their Camp level. The higher the zone level, the greater its Dojo output.
3. You can only be assigned to one competition stage each week.
4. Dojos are located within 4 elemental zones. Occupy a Dojo to collect its corresponding elemental energy. Each zone contains 1 Champion Dojo, 8 Elite Dojos, and more Common Dojos. Higher-tier Dojos grant more Output.
5. Collect from an unchallenged Dojo that has reached 100% occupation to trigger a special event and receive bonus rewards. There's also a chance to trigger a special event when plundering a Dojo with full resources.
6. You can challenge a Dojo occupied by another player. A successful challenge will transfer the Dojo to you. Your first challenge each day is free; subsequent challenges have a 10-minute cooldown and cost Pallite.
7. You can challenge Dojos occupied by other players up to 6 times per day. Challenging Dojos with more resources will yield greater rewards."
